title: R for a 3-4-5 combination
source: Theory P23-3.5 Quick check 1 (5); R = sqrt(a^2+b^2)
stem: Express \({a|int}\sin\theta+{b|int}\cos\theta\) in the form \(R\sin(\theta+\alpha)\). Write down the value of \(R\).

steps.name: A
steps.note: A is 5k. Original k=1 gives 3 sin theta + 4 cos theta and R=5.

title: Express 8 sin theta + 15 cos theta in R-form

source.note: 9709/21/O/N/15 Question 3(i) only [3]. Official QP and official MS. Part (ii) omitted.

stem:
This question is 9709/21/O/N/15 Question 3(i) only, taken from the official QP.

Express 8 sin θ + 15 cos θ in the form R sin(θ + α), where R > 0 and 0° < α < 90°. Give the value of α correct to 2 decimal places. [3]

steps.name: B
steps.note: Official MS: B1, state or imply R=17. Independent: R=sqrt(64+225)=17.

steps.name: M
steps.text_tex: Use an appropriate formula to find \(\alpha\).
steps.note: Official MS: M1, use an appropriate formula to find alpha. Independent: tan alpha=15/8.

steps.name: A
steps.note: Official MS: A1, 61.93. Independent: alpha=61.9275...=61.93 to 2 d.p.

contexts.note: Stem taken from the official QP PDF, Question 3(i) only, verified on the rendered official page. Official MS reproduced mark by mark. Paper/self-mark.
